import outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime
import outputs.Proofs.RingmasterConvergence

namespace outputs.Theorems.RingmasterUniversalTime
open OracleTemplate

noncomputable def budget : (let S := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec; S.Params → Fin S.numOracles → ℕ) := fun p _ => max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊ * ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊

theorem result : Convergence outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec budget := by sorry
